title: 1992 AMC 8 Problem 13
statement: Five test scores have a mean (average score) of \(90,\) a median (middle score) of \(91,\) and a mode (most frequent score) of \(94.\) The sum of the two lowest test scores is

answerChoices.label: E
answerChoices.text: not determined by the information given

solutions.text:
The five scores sum to \(5 \times 90 = 450.\) The median is the third score, \(91.\) Since \(94\) is the mode, it must appear at least twice, and both copies lie above the median, so the two highest scores are \(94\) and \(94.\)

The three highest scores are \(91,\) \(94,\) and \(94,\) summing to \(279.\) So the two lowest sum to \(450 - 279 = 171.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B .
